[[Enchanted Glass Kopis]] }} == Objectives == Return the Crown of Balor to Olmir Halfhorn. * [[Crown of Balor]] == Description == I promised the Explorers' League a prize whenever I left Ironforge, mostly because they wounded my pride! I dug here and there, but there wasn't much to find on this side of the island, and I'm not strong enough to take on an entire army of orcs just to fulfill my ambition. As much as it pains me, I might have to return empty-handed. Unless... How about we make a trade? An heirloom for an heirloom. You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, that sort of thing. I have this artifact I dug up on another expedition that I'm willing to trade, if you return with something from the Duke's castle. I'm man enough to admit my knowledge of Balor is quite limited, but the late Duke must have had something valuable. A sword, a shield, a crown—whatever you may find, bring it back to me, and we'll make the trade. ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Drinking Halfhorn]] * [[Enchanted Glass Kopis]] You will also receive: * 3500 XP == Progress == Did you come up with something? == Completion == While in poor condition, it is still the crown of a duke. This will prove those rascals in the Halls of Explorers wrong! Thank you, . Here is what I promised. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
